source: WWE SmackDown vs. Raw 2011 (Xbox 360 retail data in the user's PC-port gamedata): misc.pac MOVS/WAZE (move names/ids/slot-type masks), ch/chEtc.pac CHAR/PRO (movesets), CHAR/DAT (names), m.pac MVMT motion banks (record tables), string.pac table 5 (editor texts), default.xex guest code (Create-a-Moveset slot layout, evaluated by tools/svr_moves/cams_layout.py)
notes: Move id == motion id in the m.pac banks. A clip is '<CATEGORY>_<motion_id>_<sub>' with sub = (variant<<8)|role. Slot keys follow the in-game Create-a-Moveset menus (category.row[.variant].entry); 'input' is the control the editor shows next to the move (X strike, RS grapple direction, Y signature/finisher, D-pad taunt). See evidence/svr_movesets.md for formats and verification.

common.generic_motions_notes: Hand-written labels for generic (non-moveset) SvR 2011 motions. No game table names these clips; every label comes from stick-figure renders made with tools/svr_moves/stick_sheet.py (decoder: tools/svr_anim/ymotion.py, John Cena's skeleton). sheet + row are given per entry; the row list is in <sheet>.txt. Evidence levels: 'visual' = the label describes what the render shows; 'visual+data' = also backed by decoder measurements (root height, foot drift, facing, toe-vs-heel, loop flag; extracted/svr2011_moves/motion_survey_STAT.json) or by game data (superstar slots, WAZE names, WAZA/DATA cues, the in-game controls list); 'inferred' = the label also rests on context such as slot order or id family. What triggers a clip in the game (which hit strength, which direction) is NOT known. Travel directions use the facing from the hip line, calibrated on clips whose direction is unambiguous (run STAT_6803_0, forward falls 380/636, backward falls 360/601). Two-actor clips: role 0 is drawn dark, role 1 red. Clip keys use the first STAT bank that holds the key (banks 0/1/2/4); STAT bank 99 reuses 56 keys for a hand/face pose library (motion agent).

variant_patterns.meaning: variant 0 = take-off and flight, attacker only (attack window opens mid-flight and stays open); variants 30 and 40 = landing on a downed opponent (impact cue 0x56 at frame 1); variant 50 = hitting a standing opponent (0x56 at frame 9); variant 112 = landing alone (miss)
variant_patterns.evidence: visual for CORN_3529 Diving Cross Body 2 and CORN_3550 Diving Elbow Drop 1 (sheet variants_aerial.png); that other dives with the same sub pattern use it the same way is inferred

variant_patterns.meaning: variant 0 = entry (both roles), variant 50 (12800/12801) = hold loop, variant 250 (64000/64001) = second loop; variants 1, 10, 20-23, 30-33, 40-42, 55-59, 253-255 exist but were not identified
variant_patterns.evidence: visual + decoder loop flags (sheets stat_b, stat_j)

variant_patterns.meaning: 1001/1011 face-up upper body, 1051/1058 face-down upper body, 1101/1111 face-up lower body, 1151/1155 face-down lower body, 10280s face-up side, 10290s face-down side
variant_patterns.evidence: slot positions (defaults next to the editor's ground-grapple rows) + role-1 toe-vs-heel orientation + renders
